ex.en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
ex.zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。

ex.en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
ex.zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。

ex.en: The gentleman held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那位先生为我们扶住了门。

ex.en: My sister goes to high school near our home.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在家附近上高中。

ex.en: The child moved the puppet by pulling its strings.
ex.zh: 孩子拉动细线操纵木偶。

ex.en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
ex.zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。

ex.en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
ex.zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

ex.en: As a teenager, she learned to play the violin.
ex.zh: 她在青少年时期学会了拉小提琴。

ex.en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
ex.zh: 我祖父仍然用着一座带钟摆的老式时钟。

ex.en: Although some teaching methods seem old-fashioned, they can still help students develop concentration and independent thinking.
ex.zh: 尽管某些教学方法看似老式，但它们仍能帮助学生培养专注力和独立思考能力。

ex.en: Would you like to take part in the show?
ex.zh: 你想参加这场演出吗？

ex.en: The puppet performance lasted twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 木偶表演持续了二十分钟。

ex.en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
ex.zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
ex.zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

ex.en: These tiny puppets still amaze visitors today.
ex.zh: 这些小木偶如今仍让参观者惊叹。

ex.en: We will post photos of the show online.
ex.zh: 我们会在网上发布演出照片。

ex.en: The club was flooded with requests to join.
ex.zh: 社团一下子收到了大量入社申请。

ex.en: Hold on a little longer and you'll reach the top.
ex.zh: 再坚持一会儿，你就能到顶了。

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

ex.en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。

ex.en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
ex.zh: 对科学感兴趣的学生应该经常有机会开展实际实验。

ex.en: The story had a surprising ending.
ex.zh: 这个故事的结局出人意料。

senses.zh: 令人惊奇的，使人吃惊的，出人意料的

ex.en: She was so lost in her book that she didn't hear me.
ex.zh: 她读书读得入迷，没有听见我说话。

ex.en: Every viewer could see how the puppet moved.
ex.zh: 每位观众都能看到木偶是怎么动的。

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。

ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

ex.en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。

ex.en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
ex.zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。

ex.en: The club welcomes teenage musicians.
ex.zh: 社团欢迎青少年音乐爱好者。

ex.en: We learned about Chinese folk arts at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆了解了中国民间艺术。

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

ex.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。

ex.en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
ex.zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

ex.en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
ex.zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。

ex.en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
ex.zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。

ex.en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

ex.en: Our dog watched the neighbours through the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 我们的狗透过木栅栏看着邻居。

ex.en: Installing fences around protected habitats can reduce conflict between local farmers and endangered wildlife.
ex.zh: 在受保护栖息地周围安装围栏，可以减少当地农民与濒危野生动物之间的冲突。

ex.en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
ex.zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。

ex.en: Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
ex.zh: 过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。

ex.en: A scarecrow stood in the vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 菜园里立着一个稻草人。

ex.en: The educator helped children learn through art.
ex.zh: 这位教育家帮助孩子通过艺术学习。

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

ex.en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
ex.zh: 全国各地的球迷都在庆祝这支球队获胜。

ex.en: Wealthier nations should support international efforts to improve access to clean water in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 较富裕的国家应支持国际合作，改善贫困地区的清洁用水条件。

ex.en: We must shoulder the responsibility of looking after our class pet.
ex.zh: 我们必须承担照顾班级宠物的责任。

ex.en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
ex.zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

ex.en: Many young people spend their youth exploring new interests.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人在青春岁月里探索新的兴趣。

ex.en: A wealthy neighbour donated new equipment to our playground.
ex.zh: 一位富裕的邻居为我们的游乐场捐赠了新设备。

ex.en: Wealthy countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资较贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

ex.en: She became more independent after joining the club.
ex.zh: 加入社团后，她变得更加独立。

ex.en: The teacher read a short excerpt from the book.
ex.zh: 老师读了书中的一小段节选。

senses.zh: （书籍、诗歌、音乐等的）摘录，节录

ex.en: She keeps her buttons in a small tin.
ex.zh: 她把纽扣放在一个小金属盒里。

ex.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
ex.zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。

ex.en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
ex.zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

ex.en: He put the coin into his moneybox.
ex.zh: 他把硬币放进自己的存钱罐。

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

ex.en: The instructions make sense when you see the model.
ex.zh: 看到模型后，这些说明就容易理解了。

ex.en: In dreamland, she flew over a castle in the clouds.
ex.zh: 在梦里，她飞过了云中的一座城堡。

ex.en: We managed to finish before dark.
ex.zh: 我们设法在天黑前完成了。

senses.zh: 成功应付，得以对付过去

ex.en: Careful planning is the key to success.
ex.zh: 周密的计划是成功的关键。

ex.en: She knows how to deal calmly with problems.
ex.zh: 她知道如何冷静地应对问题。

ex.en: We worked together to deal with the mess.
ex.zh: 我们一起处理了这堆乱糟糟的东西。

ex.en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。

ex.en: Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。

senses.zh: 笔记本电脑，便携式电脑

ex.en: We have a small budget for our weekend trip.
ex.zh: 我们周末旅行的预算不多。

ex.en: Local governments should allocate a larger share of their budget to maintaining public transport systems.
ex.zh: 地方政府应将更大比例的预算用于维护公共交通系统。

ex.en: That's exactly what I meant.
ex.zh: 这正是我的意思。

ex.en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。

ex.en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。

ex.en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
ex.zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。

ex.en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。

senses.zh: 最后部分，末尾；v. 结束，停止

ex.en: I save a little money every week.
ex.zh: 我每周存一点钱。

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex.zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

ex.en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。

ex.en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
ex.zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。

ex.en: Transport costs account for a substantial share of household spending, particularly in areas with limited public services.
ex.zh: 交通费用占家庭支出的很大一部分，在公共服务有限的地区尤其如此。

ex.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
ex.zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。

ex.en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

ex.en: She used some of her savings to buy a bike.
ex.zh: 她用部分积蓄买了一辆自行车。

senses.zh: 积蓄；（尤指）银行存款，储蓄金

ex.en: The family had to plan carefully to make ends meet.
ex.zh: 这一家人必须精打细算才能维持生计。

senses.zh: 使收支仅能相抵，勉强维持生计

ex.en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
ex.zh: 你选好野餐的日期了吗？

ex.en: Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用附近发现的木制工具确定这座古村落遗迹的年代。

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

ex.en: These shirts are on sale this week.
ex.zh: 这些衬衫本周打折。

ex.en: He wore a blue T-shirt to the picnic.
ex.zh: 他穿着一件蓝色T恤去野餐。

ex.en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
ex.zh: 我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。

ex.en: A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
ex.zh: 设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。

ex.en: The old watch is worth more than I expected.
ex.zh: 这块旧手表比我预想的更值钱。

ex.en: I paid one dollar for this small notebook.
ex.zh: 我花了一美元买这本小笔记本。

ex.en: A stronger dollar can make imported goods cheaper for American consumers while increasing costs for overseas buyers.
ex.zh: 美元走强可使美国消费者购买进口商品更便宜，同时增加海外买家的成本。

ex.en: I found a coin worth one cent.
ex.zh: 我找到了一枚面值一美分的硬币。

ex.en: She picked up a penny from the floor.
ex.zh: 她从地板上捡起一枚一美分硬币。

senses.zh: 一分钱硬币（美国或加拿大货币）

ex.en: The couple went for a walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 这对夫妇晚饭后去散步了。

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。

ex.en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。

senses.zh: 一套住房，一套公寓房，单元房

ex.en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
ex.zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。

ex.en: Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存文化珍宝，让后代能够了解早期社会的成就和传统。

ex.en: We wrapped presents on Christmas Eve.
ex.zh: 我们在平安夜包装礼物。

ex.en: You can certainly borrow my book.
ex.zh: 你当然可以借我的书。

ex.en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
ex.zh: 他用一条沉重的金属链锁好了自行车。

ex.en: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
ex.zh: 大型连锁超市可以提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁独立小商店。

ex.en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出梳子，梳理了一下头发。

ex.en: Volunteers combed the beach for plastic waste before the start of the summer tourist season.
ex.zh: 暑期旅游季开始前，志愿者仔细搜寻海滩上的塑料垃圾。

ex.en: Our guest showed us how to make a puppet.
ex.zh: 我们的嘉宾教我们制作木偶。

ex.en: We visited the remains of an ancient town.
ex.zh: 我们参观了一座古城的遗迹。

ex.en: The village lies between the river and the hills.
ex.zh: 村庄位于河流和山丘之间。

ex.en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
ex.zh: 我们的小木屋位于岛的西北部。

ex.en: Investment in rail networks could improve access to employment for communities in the northwest of the country.
ex.zh: 对铁路网的投资可以为该国西北部的社区提供更多就业便利。

ex.en: It was such a beautiful day that we stayed outside.
ex.zh: 天气这么好，我们就一直待在户外。

senses.zh: 这样，如此，非常（用于强调）

ex.en: The archaeologist gently brushed soil from a clay bowl.
ex.zh: 考古学家轻轻刷去陶碗上的泥土。

ex.en: An archaeologist can reveal how ancient communities adapted to environmental change by examining tools and settlement patterns.
ex.zh: 考古学家可以通过研究工具和聚落分布，揭示古代群体如何适应环境变化。

ex.en: In the story, a giant lived above the clouds.
ex.zh: 故事里有个巨人住在云上。

ex.en: The finished model was the fruit of months of work.
ex.zh: 做好的模型是几个月努力的成果。

ex.en: We placed a vase in the centre of the table.
ex.zh: 我们在桌子中央摆了一个花瓶。

ex.en: A new community centre could provide affordable exercise facilities and meeting spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 新的社区中心可以为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身设施和聚会场所。

ex.en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。

ex.en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
ex.zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。

ex.en: Dark clouds began to form over the hills.
ex.zh: 山丘上空开始聚起乌云。

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。

ex.en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
ex.zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

ex.en: The show went smoothly from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 演出从头到尾进行得很顺利。

ex.en: We wished her good luck before the show.
ex.zh: 演出前，我们祝她好运。

ex.en: The light brings out the colours in the painting.
ex.zh: 灯光使画中的色彩更鲜明。

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

ex.en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。

ex.en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。

ex.en: The old matchbox held only two matches.
ex.zh: 旧火柴盒里只剩两根火柴。

ex.en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。

ex.en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
ex.zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。
